# ms/segment where the untuned-gate pick of band 2048 measures 16.07 -- both
# at 0/842. The cells are timed with one template at batch 64 against a
# synthetic reference, which reproduces neither the bank nor the block
# structure of a real workload. Accuracy selection is sound; cost ranking is
# not, and it is cost that decides which admissible option wins.
